name: CHAOS [EVENT]
desc:
Welcome to Chaos!

[NEW UPDATE v1.4: We added a Mobile Button And Reverted Old HitBox as requested ]

A fun fighting game where you can slap people to the afterlife. This game is in early stages and might contain a lot of bugs!

Controls:
CTRL - Shiftlock
E - Dash
F - Carry
